tasks.title: Optional-capacity insertion-order cache
tasks.instruction: Insert the supplied [string key, JSON value] pairs into a cache and return its [key, value] pairs in insertion order. Keys in the input are unique. None or zero capacity means unlimited; positive integer capacities keep the newest capacity entries by evicting the oldest before insertion. Empty input returns []. Repeated-key updates and negative limits are outside scope.

tasks.title: Factory dispatch and invalid construction
tasks.instruction: Dispatch construction for the supplied inert Probe factories. methods lists available settings/crawler factories; otherwise use direct construction. If settings and crawler_settings are both None raise ValueError. When settings is None adopt crawler_settings. Prefer a crawler factory when a crawler exists, then a settings factory, then direct construction. Factories normally return {via, source, args, kwargs}; source is the settings actually supplied to that factory, or None for direct. returns overrides a factory result by its name (crawler/settings/direct). Raise TypeError if and only if the selected factory returns None; preserve other false-like results. Forward args/kwargs unchanged. No actual Scrapy crawler is run.

tasks.title: Pending tasks belong to the requesting worker
tasks.instruction: Given a worker ID and unique task rows [id, status, worker_ids], return sorted IDs assigned to that worker with status PENDING or RUNNING. Ignore DONE/FAILED tasks and tasks owned only by other workers; a shared task belongs to every listed worker. This must hold whether there are many completed tasks, few worker tasks, or no tasks. State adapters expose exactly the pending/running union and its size. No live scheduler is run.

tasks.title: Periodic deadline arithmetic with backward clock movement
tasks.instruction: Advance a periodic timer for each supplied current time and return the deadlines. period_ms is positive; initial_deadline and current_times are seconds. If the previous deadline is at or before now, advance by the smallest positive whole number of periods that makes it strictly later than now. If now is earlier than the deadline, still advance the deadline by one period. Process the sequence in order, preserving the phase when skipping overrun cycles. Empty current_times returns []. This deterministic arithmetic task does not sleep, call a callback, or read a clock. Return floating-point seconds; the adapter normalizes numeric deadlines to float.

tasks.title: Empty lazy command sequence and preserved ordering
tasks.instruction: Observe a lazy command sequence using actions list, len, truthy or first, returning one result per action. commands contains unique script strings with distinct integer priorities. The first input command stays first; once realized, remaining commands are sorted by ascending priority. Empty sequences have list [], length 0 and false truthiness; first on empty raises IndexError. Repeated observations are stable. All side effects are None, and no command is executed. Duplicate scripts, equal priorities and side effects are outside scope.

tasks.title: Default settings merge without overwriting configured values
tasks.instruction: Return original settings, merged settings and attribute lookup values. Merge defaults only for keys absent from existing; existing values including False, zero, empty strings and None win. Do not mutate existing settings. Unset attribute lookups return None. Inputs use ordinary string keys that do not shadow dict methods; nested JSON values are preserved as values, not recursively merged.
